scope: 原站HTTP协议、字段语义、完整Round/Step/Delivery状态机；不定义Java实现或平台Redis私有契约

staticVisualTruth: 页面标题、规则文本、奖表显示、语言资源、按钮与菜单可见性
interfaceBehaviorTruth: 端点、请求字段、表单编码、响应字段、相邻Step、Round终止与历史合并
truthBoundary.rule: 视觉常量仅在同时有规则、config、前端判定或抓包行为证据时才能成为协议语义；投注因子30不是中奖线数量

encryption.contract: token is opaque and must never be decoded for game-state logic; no custom request encryption or response decryption may be invented

endpoints.resumeRule: when last is non-null, frontend treats last.fsn!=last.nfsc as unfinished content

endpoints.order: paid start and every free continuation Step

optionalPlatformField.reason: only conditionally sent for platform activityFree; current auth/config did not grant that mode

endpoints.mergeRule: orderedSteps = bsl followed by fsl; every element remains one Step of the same paid Round

endpoints.activation: only when auth response ping.enable is truthy

firstLoad: if CONFIG.last is unfinished, restore that state before permitting a new paid Round
ordinaryPaidRound: if fsn=0, terminate the Round after this single Step
freeSpinRound: while fsn>nfsc, call the same SPIN request and append response to the same Round
historyReconciliation: for the selected ll[].tis call LOG_VIEW(transfer_id=tis)
append bsl then fsl and verify the same fsn/nfsc termination rule

roundIdentity.paidRound: begins at the first SPIN outside an active Round
roundIdentity.roundId: local capture/delivery identifier and not an original response field
roundIdentity.historyAssociation: one log-list transfer id tis groups log-view bsl and fsl

states.transitionRule: each response increments nfsc by one in captured sequences; keep the Step under the original Round

states.outputs: one complete Round ready for one-time member delivery

stateMachine.stepBoundary: one SPIN response equals one Step
stateMachine.roundBoundary: one paid Step plus zero or more free Steps through the terminal predicate
stateMachine.deliveryBoundary: generate/claim once at paid start, then consume stored adjacent Steps; never regenerate the active Round per request
stateMachine.ssBoundary: ss=0 was observed on final free Step, but ordinary terminal Steps can have ss=1; ss is not the universal termination predicate

gameRules.winModel: 243 fixed Ways, consecutive from leftmost reel
gameRules.wild: WILD substitutes all except SC and only appears on reels 2/3/4
gameRules.freeSpins: 3/4/5 SC grants 12/15/20; initial x2; consume 3 collected WILD to add 2 and retain the remainder; maximum x20; SC absent during free mode

amountSemantics.ba: Step bet amount; 0.60 on paid start and 0.00 on captured free Steps
amountSemantics.rwa: observed cumulative win amount of the Round
amountSemantics.rpx: paid value 1; free multiplier starts at 2 and follows the confirmed Wild-collection rule
amountSemantics.pl.balance: updated player balance when present in direct spin response

unknownAndForbiddenInferences: buffer cells are UNKNOWN; do not invent beyond the 15 visible rskl entries
20 free Spins and multipliers above x10 have rules evidence but no captured complete-Round sample
fixtures and captured responses are independent test oracles only and may not be runtime result sources
Original reel strips and RTP unknown; local empirical transition counts are explicitly labelled and do not claim original probabilities
Local Redis contract follows the user mandate, not an example game or original upstream HTTP evidence

validationRequirements.freeStepOrder: FREE_SPINS局在付费Step后，nfsc必须严格为1..fsn，末Step满足nfsc=fsn

runtimeDeliveryContract.scope: local downstream contract, not original upstream protocol
selection: uniform existing positive integer multiplier for win, zero for loss
atomic LPOP of exactly one member
remaining deliveries only from that member
runtimeDeliveryContract.memberEncoding: one digit 0..9 per visible cell; 15 cells per board; | between steps
